answer_4.guideline: We focus on evaluate the machine-generated response from four perspectives: (1) Sensibleness (Sens) and (2) Engagement (Enga) for open-domain chatbots, we further evaluate on (3) Factuality (Fact) and (4) Informativeness (Info) to see if models can actively provide informative responses based on movie facts.
